newsitem.title: POLAND: Agros to invest PLN 300 mln in 1997-98.
newsitem.headline: Agros to invest PLN 300 mln in 1997-98.

text.p: Polish food producer and trader Agros Holding SA plans to invest 300 million zlotys ($92.7 million) by the end of 1998, of which half will be spent on buying firms from the food sector, the firm said in a statement on Wednesday.

"The whole investment programme involves 300 million zlotys. About 150 million zlotys will be spent on expanding the group into new entities operating in the food industry and agriculture sector," the statement said.
The investment programme will mostly be financed from a recent issue of 2.4 million new shares sold at 70 zlotys each.
